subject: SOC 2 Type II: initial request, audit window clarification, and reply templates
messages:
From: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.com>
To: Laura Gomez <laura.gomez@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SOC 2 Type II request — initial asks and options for sharing

Hi Laura,

Thanks for the quick intro call yesterday. Per our conversation, Acme Health has asked for Redwood's SOC 2 Type II (coverage through controls for the audit period) and a short bridge/coverage note if the most recent report's audit period doesn't align with your review window. To move quickly, we typically ask for: a minimal evidence inventory (see attached checklist), the most recent Type II report PDF (if available), and one of the bridge-letter templates depending on the timing.

A few clarifying questions to make sure we send what you need:
- What exact audit period do you need coverage for (start/end dates)?
- Do you require a signed bridge letter from our auditor or is a company bridge letter acceptable?
- Preferred transfer method: presigned S3 link, secure Drive share, or vendor portal? We can also provide an SFTP option.

Attachments: soc2-evidence-checklist_v1.xlsx (minimal evidence matrix), bridge-letter-options.docx (sample wordings), access-presigned-s3-instructions.txt (how to upload via presigned link).

If you confirm the audit window and preferred transfer option we’ll send the report + recommended bridge wording and a short reply template your procurement/legal team can use.

Next steps:
1) Reply with audit period + preferred transfer method
2) We’ll provide presigned upload URL (or Drive link) and the bridge-letter options within 24 hours

Thanks — talk soon.

Ethan Park
Senior Security Liaison
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Gomez <laura.gomez@acmehealth.com>
To: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.com>, Acme Health Security <security@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2028-07-08T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II request — initial asks and options for sharing

Hi Ethan — thanks for the clear ask. A couple quick answers from our side:

- Audit window: looking for continuous coverage covering 2027-01-01 through 2027-12-31 (calendar 2027).
- Bridge letter: procurement prefers an auditor-issued bridge if the report doesn't cover that window, but legal can accept a company-signed bridge if the auditor option isn’t available.
- Transfer method: presigned S3 is our preference; secure Drive is OK for redacted docs.

Can you confirm whether the current Type II you have covers 2027? If not, the auditor bridge timeline is important to us. Also: is there an easy one-line template procurement can paste into their request if they need to escalate?

Thanks,
Laura
Head of Vendor Risk
Acme Health
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-08T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: RE: SOC 2 Type II request — suggested reply + minimal evidence set (internal)

Ethan / Neha — quick internal notes:
- Our latest Type II report covers audit period 2026-07-01 through 2027-06-30 (so it does NOT fully cover calendar 2027). We should offer: (A) auditor-issued bridge (if auditor can provide one for the 2027 tail) OR (B) company bridge + controls snapshot for remainder of 2027.
- Recommend we surface the following minimal evidence items to speed review: system configuration snapshots (host inventory), user access review logs for key apps (sample for a 30-day window), change control ticket extract (two representative PRs), and retention policy doc. I added these to the attached checklist.
- For procurement/legal, provide two short reply snippets: one for procurement (upload + timeline) and one for legal (bridge wording acceptance). See templates below.

Procurement snippet: "Redwood will provide the Type II report and a bridge covering 2027; we will upload documents to a presigned S3 link within 48 hours of approval. Please confirm a contact for the S3 transfer."

Legal snippet: "If an auditor-issued bridge is not available, Redwood will provide a company-signed bridge letter and a controls snapshot for the uncovered period. Redwood is open to reasonable redactions for customer-sensitive fields."

I recommend presigned S3 and we should include an expiration (7 days). Neha — can you draft the presigned URL flow and short instructions?

Kim
Director, Compliance Ops

Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II request — initial asks and options for sharing

Hi Laura — thanks for the quick turnaround and clarity on the audit window. A short update and attached templates below.

Summary: Our current SOC 2 Type II covers 2026-07-01 through 2027-06-30 and therefore does not fully cover calendar 2027. We can support Acme Health with the following:

1) Auditor bridge: We’ve requested an auditor-issued bridge for coverage through 2027-12-31. If the auditor can provide that, we will deliver the signed bridge and the Type II PDF.

2) Company bridge + evidence snapshot: If the auditor bridge will be delayed, we will provide a Redwood-signed bridge letter plus a controls snapshot (minimal evidence set) that covers July–Dec 2027. The attached checklist highlights the prioritized artifacts (host inventory snapshot, sample access review, change control extract, retention/configuration policies).

3) Transfer method: presigned S3 is fine — we will issue a presigned upload link (7-day expiry) and a short README with upload steps. See attached instructions.

Procurement one-liner (copy/paste):
"Redwood will upload the requested Type II report and any bridge letter to a presigned S3 link within 48 hours of confirmation. Please confirm the contact for the S3 upload and any IP address allowlist if required."

Legal one-liner (copy/paste):
"If an auditor-issued bridge cannot be provided by the auditor in the required timeframe, Redwood will provide a company-signed bridge letter and a controls snapshot covering the uncovered months; Redwood will work with Acme on reasonable redactions."

Next steps:
- Please confirm: (A) proceed with vendor-presigned S3 (we’ll send URL and README) and (B) whether procurement/legal prefer auditor-bridge first or company-bridge as fallback.
- We’ll send the presigned link plus the Type II PDF + bridge (as available) within 48 hours of your reply.

Attachments: soc2-evidence-checklist_v1.xlsx, bridge-letter-options.docx, access-presigned-s3-instructions.txt

Best,
Ethan
Senior Security Liaison
Redwood Inference
